## Sensitive data and provenance review

- [ ] Neither this change nor this pull request (description, comments, screenshots,
      commit messages) contains student work, marks, feedback, personal data,
      confidential assessment material, or secrets. Fixtures are synthetic.
- [ ] Educator control is preserved: no AI output becomes a mark, judgement, or released
      feedback without explicit educator action.
- [ ] Provenance is preserved for any transformed rubric, submission, mark, or feedback.
- [ ] No assessment material can leave the local machine unless it has been anonymised
      and approved by the educator. This safeguard is mandatory; any other change to
      data-handling boundaries is backed by a recorded decision in `docs/decisions/`.
- [ ] Affected documentation (product, architecture, data handling) is accurate.
